nativeAcceptance.testFrameworkRows: Five existing [Fact] methods. No theory, InlineData, MemberData or parameter rows in this class.
nativeAcceptance.runtimePolicy: Observe generated runtimeconfig and loaded runtime. Do not equate transport/ref-pack/Arcade version with loaded runtime and do not override RuntimeFrameworkVersion.
nativeAcceptance.sourcePolicy: Build each detached checkout's own unchanged source and actual restored project-reference graph; document explicit JS/ANCM/static-assets exclusions after observed prerequisite failures.
nativeAcceptance.auditPolicy: Selected-file hashes, Git/LF versus physical source, selected PE/PDB pairing and Document source checksums, parsed native XML rows/IDs/counters, and selected loaded-image identities must be checked offline from capsule-relative files.
nativeAcceptance.terminalPolicy: Owned launchers and output streams terminal; distinguish bounded process observations from exhaustive descendant census.

evidenceKind.thisFile: Saved source-inspection/assertion-ownership receipt, not a runtime value dump. Passing native test rows establish that their existing assertions completed.
evidenceKind.rawRuntimeFacts: Native TRX/XML and exit-time loaded-image receipts are separate selected files; portable audit reparses the TRX and binary/PDB/source bytes.
evidenceKind.frequency: One source-local serializer construction and one ReadObject or WriteObject call per Fact invocation. Native run receipts identify every invocation, including any identity-capture rerun; no production request-rate, hot-loop workload, cache reuse, allocation or timing evidence.
evidenceKind.lifetime: Read serializers are method locals; write serializers are locals inside the test's XmlWriter using scope. No shared fixture, static serializer, singleton/DI registration or construction loop in the five methods. Scope exit is not proof of collection or disposal.
evidenceKind.producerConsumer: Existing real DataContractSerializer ReadObject/WriteObject is the producer/consumer mechanism. It invokes the real IXmlSerializable wrapper implementation; no shipping bodies or substituted calls are compiled into a replacement consumer.
